title: Event day reminder
description: Remind attendees the day before an event with doors time and venue. Appointment reminder WhatsApp template for events. Free to copy and edit.
notes: Include doors-open time and venue. Send the evening before for the best read rate.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, *{{event_name}}* is tomorrow at {{venue}}. Doors open at {{time}}. Have your tickets ready on your phone.
